resources.string:
Drydock lets a coding agent live and work on your phone.

First time: complete setup under Settings → Setup wizard (keep-alive, connect a model, install agents), then tap New session to open a terminal — OpenCode or pi will just work.

API keys go through environment variables: send your key to the agent in the terminal and it will write it to ~/.drydock/env.sh; sessions survive screen-off, and output files are visible in the phone's file manager.
Each session is an independent terminal; sessions do not affect each other and can run different tasks at the same time.
A dtach session has no service process: after closing, the contents of this session (including the agent TUI) are lost, and reopening starts a fresh shell.
When all sessions are closed, the main terminal is rebuilt automatically on next open.
